title: Rosette dado of the Salón de Comares west wall, Alhambra
subtitle: Salón de Comares, Alhambra, Granada

given.O: The centre of the star in the middle of the rosette.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s F169 drawing, an interlace of bands, by their centre lines. Its tile corners were snapped to the square-root-of-two grid in star-radius units. After the unit star every line, the tile’s sides too, is drawn through a crossing of earlier lines and turned round O. Two of those lines are helpers that the finished pattern does not use: no crossing of the pattern’s own lines lies on another of its lines. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The lines are the centre lines of the drawing’s bands; the over-and-under weave is not drawn. The colours follow Wichmann’s drawing, which keeps the panel’s own: black, teal, honey and blue, in the Alhambra palette; the bands themselves are not pieces. No photograph was checked.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data150/F169: Salón de Comares, Alhambra, Granada
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. He drew it from Antonio Fernández-Puertas, The Alhambra, volume I (1997), page 345, figure 169: one of a pair of square alicatado panels on the west wall of the Salón de Comares, between the three window alcoves (1350s).

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at C and D. The horizontal line crosses the circle at B on the left. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at E. Draw a straight line through O and E. Draw a line through O at 90° to line OE. The circle crosses the four lines through O at S1 to S8.
Draw the star at O as two squares.

parts.text: Draw a straight line through S1 and S3, S3 and S5, S5 and S7, and S7 and S1. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.
Draw a straight line through S2 and S4, S4 and S6, S6 and S8, and S8 and S2. Draw each line long, beyond the circle.

steps.text: The horizontal line through C crosses the line from S5 to S7 at P1. Draw a line through P1 parallel to line OE. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The horizontal line through C crosses the line through P1 parallel to line OE, turned by 90°, at P2. Draw a line through P2 parallel to line OE. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
The line from S7 to S1 crosses the line through P2 parallel to line OE, turned by 315°, at P3. Draw a vertical line through P3. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The line from S7 to S1 crosses the line through P2 parallel to line OE, turned by 315°, at P3. Draw a vertical line through P3. Turn copies of it round O by 45°, by 135° and by 315°.

steps.text: The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P3, turned by 45°, at P4. The line from S3 to S5 crosses the vertical line through P3 at P5. The line through P1 parallel to line OE crosses the vertical line through P3 at P6. Draw a vertical line through P4. Draw a horizontal line through P5. Draw a horizontal line through P6. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The vertical line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P6, turned by 315°, at P7. Draw a horizontal line through P7. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The vertical line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P7, turned by 315°, at P8. The line through P2 parallel to line OE crosses the vertical line through P3 at P9. Draw a horizontal line through P8. Draw a horizontal line through P9. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.

The vertical line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P9, turned by 315°, at P10. The vertical line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P8, turned by 45°, at P11. The vertical line through P3 crosses the vertical line through P3, turned by 135°, at P12. Draw a horizontal line through P10. Draw a horizontal line through P11. Draw a horizontal line through P12. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The vertical line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P5, turned by 45°, at P13. Draw a horizontal line through P13. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The vertical line through P3 crosses the horizontal line through P13, turned by 315°, at P14. The horizontal line through C crosses the horizontal line through P5, turned by 135°, at P15. Draw a horizontal line through P14. Draw a line through P15 parallel to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 45°, seven times.
The vertical line through P3 crosses the line through P15 parallel to line OE at P16. Draw a horizontal line through P16. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.

The vertical line through P3, turned by 135°, crosses the horizontal line through P16 at P17. The vertical line through P3, turned by 315°, crosses the horizontal line through P10 at P18. The vertical line through P3, turned by 315°, crosses the horizontal line through P11 at P19. Draw a line through P17 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P18 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P19 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.
The line from S1 to S3 crosses the line from S8 to S2 at P20. Draw a horizontal line through P20. Turn it round O by 45°, seven times.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The line from S1 to S3 crosses the line from S8 to S2 at P20. Draw a horizontal line through P20. Turn it round O by 225°.

steps.text: The horizontal line through P14 crosses the horizontal line through P20, turned by 225°, at P21. The horizontal line through P16 crosses the horizontal line through P20, turned by 225°, at P22. Draw a line through P21 at 90° to line OE. Draw a line through P22 at 90° to line OE. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.

The line from S7 to S1 crosses the line through P22 at 90° to line OE at T. Draw a vertical line through T. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They are the middles of the interlaced bands.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. A rosette sits at the centre of every tile.
